These support a clear positive contribution across access, protection, crisis/transition administration, and institutional mechanisms. However, evidence of service quality and durable outcomes is limited; food insecurity increased, educational performance deteriorated with weak federal attribution, and several welfare domains remain unevaluated. This is a solid but bounded middle-high performance rather than broad transformative welfare improvement.","chapter_specific":[{"field":"evidenced_service_domains","value":"Health-insurance access and affordability, Medicare implementation, housing and veteran-homelessness program outputs, reproductive-access defense, and education/food-security outcomes."},{"field":"distribution_and_dignity","value":"Subsidies, Navigators, Medicaid-to-Marketplace transition support, veteran housing, and reproductive-access defense indicate attention to vulnerable groups;
